change: Warn on known nondeterministic operations and global mutations through directly supplied tick functions and their user helper calls.
adaptations: Check-only mode scans checked calls, including entry functions not scheduled for lowering.
unix_time(Date) is a deterministic conversion, not a clock read.
Advice uses the game fixed timestep rather than asserting every tick lasts 1/60 s.
bootstrap: Independent included C seed, three compiler generations.
coverage: Native/web default/release named and inline ticks, helper and recursive calls, clock/input/global RNG/global writes, seeded RNG and shuffle, user-defined random, pure date conversion, sessions in main and at module scope. Native check diagnostics and existing rollback simulations included.
limits: Advisory warnings, not a determinism proof. Indirect callbacks, external calls and captured state are not comprehensively analyzed. Compilation timings are local alternating warmed-process measurements with other work on the host; no speedup claim.
